verdict.rationale: Consensus lets users import their own PDFs (and BibTex/RIS) into a Library and then search, find gaps, and 'put your collection to work' with AI-powered workspace features, which supports research over a user's own corpus. However, evidence doesn't clearly confirm deep synthesis/Q&A or full-text extraction specifically applied to arbitrary uploaded PDFs versus Consensus's own indexed papers. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of full-text analysis/synthesis pipeline running on user-uploaded PDFs, and independent/hands-on confirmation of this workflow.
